title: Bound the PR5580 κ .0033 budget and ideal isolated-tail edit counts
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This composite adds a historical exact [PR #5569](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5569) price certificate and a separate current [PR #5580](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5580) analytic transfer/count certificate. For exact [PR #5580](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5580) head `6efa248cf456d6101d757e9d09ba29711d18a13a`, the optimistic strict-single-use isolated-tail class needs at least **146 ideal exchanges per FULL** with the permitted controller law, or **147** with the submitted 18-FULL caller retained, at $C=.0033$ and $C=.0033000005$.

The source paid change is `+H2−2H3+H4` per FULL, with targets unchanged. The current certificate transfers the authenticated [PR #5569](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5569) B/J intervals through `B5580=B5569−gD`, where `gD=2H3−H2−H4`. At $C=.0033$:

$$
2.95302944896150557847079 < B5580 < 2.95303581796150557847087.
$$

The count proof charges the productive rank loss of every isolated tail. Granted multiset witnesses use 94H4+52H5 for 146/n17 and 94H4+53H5 for 147/n18, with complete paid/target/surplus 60604/12079/712 and 64206/12814/760. Their complete raw slack is positive but below one global H1; an added uncompensated global H1 defeats these particular witnesses. Every query, whole idle and main bank is charged. Ordinary costs and compiler reserve remain separate.

This is an exact two-point necessary-budget/count result in an explicitly optimistic accounting class. It finds no actual 146/147 contacts, establishes no compatible source edits, constructs no 17-call caller, certifies no new funded κ and changes no selected result. Frame/endpoint/native, uniform precision/tape and complete compiler/outer premises remain open. Balanced concavity and the [PR #5554](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5554) all-n implication are paper arguments, not a proof-kernel theorem. There is no larger-C or general P104 ceiling claim.

## Task and overlap

Publication head `c8b49410fb31d107d8c85d160ac5ca737c403231`, tested tree `7e102b38d64ca97c43f0648ac8e275a3918ed111`, directly based on `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`. Current upstream main `5e0052ca0aa3036a3afa8b0438927377c8d97d53` and guidance were checked separately at the 21:09 UTC prepublication checkpoint. Both package byte sets and source history were checked against the exact remote commit; 87 files are added.

Task `scalar-to-moment`, priority revision 7, changed scope. The original construction-gain gate is not met. The useful contribution is a current complete aggregate budget that prevents one attractive isolated contact from being mistaken for a complete .0033 route.

- `research/p104-successor-price-gate`: immutable 37-file historical [PR #5569](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5569) certificate at head `af9f091ac6f30c6eaacb9c27777bfbe2d0e5ffdf`.
- `research/p104-current-tail-count`: separate current certificate for Ali Romman's [PR5580](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5580), exact head `6efa248cf456d6101d757e9d09ba29711d18a13a`.

GamingPuzzled's [PR #5569](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5569)/[PR #5472](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5472) supply the predecessor handoff/cost lineage; zxv's [PR #5554](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5554) supplies the all-controller reduction. [PR #5585](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5585)'s native work is distinct from this price/count artifact. [PR #5579](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5579)'s fixed-anchor owned holder obstruction is tied to its [PR #5561](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5561)/[PR #5569](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5569) sources and does not transfer automatically to [PR #5580](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5580)'s changed anchor. Constructive inventories remain outside this package. A broader A/B/C/D accounting family is under separate paper assessment, outside isolated tails; no resulting theorem or physical composition is claimed here. No exhaustive novelty claim is made.

## Validation

Original current qualification: one root-reviewed normal/optimized pair, 0.905806529 seconds and 63,401,984 bytes sampled descendant RSS under the unchanged 150 second / 512 MiB serial guard. All 25 classified controls rejected and every scientific output byte matched, with zero exclusions. Result: `f0ab2ed10f91a5acd76c1c6753d970c59e51e83c3d0b96fe8a6a3a6c3f80e9de`.

The current wrapper preserves check.py, finite.py, request, inputs, both results and guard/log byte for byte. It authenticates every package/input byte, executes only the current finite certificate in an isolated private child limited to 60 seconds / 512 MiB, compares complete original output, then reauthenticates. It imports no price engine, source constructor or native module. Both source RESULT serializations and their explicit custody revision are retained; the historical derived hash was not silently replaced by the exact author-text hash.

Current-package commands:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-current-tail-count --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-current-tail-count
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-current-tail-count --check-source-history
```

Expected marker: `PASS_P104_CURRENT_TAIL_COUNT`. The historical package retains its own registered reproduction command and evidence unchanged; its science is not rerun as part of this static preparation.

Portable current normal/-O registered replay passed in 1.714 seconds, sampled 88.61 MiB, under the unchanged 150 seconds / 512 MiB guard. Separate read-only Git-free optimized export with spaces and empty PATH passed in .705 seconds, sampled 63.70 MiB; all 51 exported files remained unchanged. Three custody corruptions reject before science in both modes. Metadata and 50-file exact committed-byte/history checks passed.

The historical component independently passed its portable registered pair in 1.912 seconds, sampled 73.89 MiB, and read-only optimized export in .906 seconds, sampled 48.84 MiB; all 38 exported files remained unchanged. Its 37 scientific-package files are preserved exactly. Local checks are scoped; hosted CI is pending at submission.

The three portable source/result/raw-serialization corruptions use `--integrity-only` and must reject before science. Export execution should use read-only files, empty PATH, an absolute interpreter and complete before/after file hashes. `VERIFY.inputs=[]` is intentional: all runtime source bytes are inside each package, so no machine-local path is declared as a repository input.

The historical numerical engine retains its original authorship and notices; the current certificate imports no engine. Paper analysis, finite qualification and packaging for Chris R/Clear1nsight used substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. Root agent code/proof review and two-mode reproduction do not constitute independent human/formal acceptance.

## Open next questions

See both packages' NEXT.md, especially `research/p104-current-tail-count/NEXT.md`. A physical proposal must supply distinct actual helper/terminal-MOVE IDs, legal source windows/charts, ownership, compatibility, all changed paid/target/ordinary costs and compiler reserves. Aggregate ideal counts alone are insufficient. Broader A/B/C/D economics need a separately defined complete family and review. Independent human/formal review of the retained analytic implications is useful; no construction or contact scan is dispatched by this publication.


Current overlap/context: [PR5590](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5590), head `627160c5e39501b69603c3a1e03bbfdc50a53a86`, reports a sharp price floor for fixed scalar contacts and arbitrary frame paths on [PR #5580](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5580). We have not replayed that proof. It is distinct from this explicitly optimistic inventory class, which grants contacts/attachments and does not assert physical realization. [Discussion5575](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5575) now owns the specified commuting-ADD/order plus intermediate-frame optimization; [Discussion5125](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125) owns joint input/output basis splitting. A future constructive task must coordinate with those owners; this publication reserves no contact search.
